<message>
ok brain dump before i forget, hub stuff first. inbox rows r still too tall on the laptop. the settings page scrolls weird. want a shortcut for a new chat. terminal font is tiny. notes shud sync between windows. let me pin a chat to the top. the rail badge doesnt clear after i answer something. today shud show what finished overnight at the top. make the send button not jump when the text wraps. teh model picker forgets my pick after restart. add a little undo after archive. dark mode the code blocks r unreadable. search in a chat would be nice. being built list shud group by project not by time. the archive button sits too close to delete. and the dock icon badge is wrong half the time
</message>

<reply>
Sixteen hub things, in the order you said them. None of this is Tally code, so I’m not putting it on a Tally worker. I’ll file it in your words, then only the clear fixes go up as hub changes for you to apply.

1. Inbox rows still too tall on the laptop
2. Settings page scrolls weird
3. A shortcut for a new chat
4. Terminal font is tiny
5. Notes should sync between windows
6. Pin a chat to the top
7. Rail badge doesn’t clear after you answer
8. Today should show what finished overnight at the top
9. Send button jumps when the text wraps
10. Model picker forgets your pick after restart
11. A little undo after archive
12. Dark mode code blocks are unreadable
13. Search in a chat
14. Being built list grouped by project, not by time
15. Archive sits too close to delete
16. Dock icon badge is wrong half the time

Starting the ones that are already decided: row height, settings scroll, badge not clearing, send button jump, model picker memory, dark code blocks, being-built grouped by project, archive too close to delete, dock badge. The rest need a call from you before anything is built.

Needs the user: new-chat shortcut, terminal font size, whether notes sync is the notes panel on the same chat, and whether pin is one chat or several.
My pick: Cmd+N, match the chat font, sync the notes panel across windows of the same chat, several pins kept above the list.
</reply>
